titleEn: This Looks Like a Good Spot

pages.text: It was midsummer. Round shade lay beneath the yard's persimmon tree. Yuki brought out a mat and a bowl of rice.
"I'll spread the mat and eat in the shade." Yuki laid it down. "This looks like a good spot."
Yuki sat. Their back felt cool. Cicadas buzzed and buzzed.
Momo left the mat and lay right beside the trunk. "Come here." Yuki pulled Momo back.
Momo went to the trunk again. "What's so good about there?" Yuki kept spooning up rice.
The sun moved little by little. Bright sunlight fell onto the mat.
The mat grew hot, and Yuki's back stung. "My food doesn't taste good anymore."
Grandma fanned herself and asked, "Who makes the shade?" Yuki looked up at the tree.
The next day, Yuki laid the mat right beside the trunk. Momo came and sat first. "Today, I'll sit with you."
Even as the sun moved, shade covered the mat. Yuki ate the whole bowl of rice.
